messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT - Elevated 5xx + 429s from api-gateway. Graph: https://monitoring.redwood.example/graph/abc123 - more than 10% 5xx across prod us-west-2 in last 2m. Paging oncall.
Alice (oncall): saw it. I'm on the page. giving initial ack, will triage.
Ben (sre): seeing sudden spike of 429s from rate-limiter service -> followed by gateway 502/504s to runtime. Looks like quota enforcement blew up and started rejecting/backpressuring upstream.
Carla (runtime): logs show many gateway timeouts after bursts of 429s. snippet:
```
2026-03-12T14:05:02Z ERROR gateway request failed status=504 route=/v1/generate upstream=runtime-3
2026-03-12T14:05:02Z WARN rate-limiter key=customer:acmehealth allowed=false limit=100 burst=10
2026-03-12T14:05:02Z INFO runtime-kv-cache eviction klen=1024
```
Maya (support): any known customers hit? I already got a DM from AcmeHealth CTO. magnitude?
Ben (sre): approx 12% of requests -> 429, and then ~5% became 502/504s. A subset of high-qps API keys (partner tier) exhausted token buckets because of a config push 3m ago that lowered per-key burst by accident.
Dinesh (infra): I can roll back the rate-limit config on the config service; current commit 0f4a2b reduced burst from 50 -> 5. Rolling back should restore previous behavior. Command:
```
# rollback to previous config
git revert 0f4a2b -m "revert accidental burst change"
./deploy-config.sh --service rate-limiter --env prod
```
Alice (oncall): prepping mitigation. Two parallel actions: 1) quick rollback of rate-limiter config (Dinesh) 2) enable routing fallback to dedicated-capacity for affected partners (Carla/Ben). If rollback takes >5m, we fallback route.
incident-bot: Escalation: Page sent to SRE lead. ETA for human ack: 2m.
Ben (sre): applying temporary override to exempt partner keys from strict quota. command:
```
# temporary override via feature-flag service
ffctl set rate-limiter.partner-exempt true --scope=prod --expires-in 15m
```
Carla (runtime): enabling fallback route for partner keys to dedicated pool. Patching route table now:
```
kubectl patch configmap routing --patch '{"data":{"partner_pool":"dedicated-usw2"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deployment/router -n infra
```
Maya (support): draft customer-facing note for AcmeHealth: "We're aware of generation failures and elevated errors. We have a mitigation in progress and expect recovery in ~15m. We'll follow-up with root cause." Want to publish after we confirm initial fix.
Dinesh (infra): rollback applied and deploy started. Monitoring shows reduced 429s in the rate-limiter service counters at 14:07:30.
Ben (sre): after override + rollback, graph shows 429 -> 1.2% and 5xx -> 0.6%. Errors trending down. Keeping throttle and fallback in place for 20m while we observe.
Alice (oncall): good. starting incident timeline notes. Who will own postmortem?
Carla (runtime): I'll drive the postmortem with Ben. We'll collect config diff, deploy history, and load profile. Add list of affected customers and backup routing decisions.
Support Lead: thanks team. Maya please prepare the customer message and send to affected list once we confirm sub-1% errors.
Maya (support): sending tentative message to AcmeHealth now (DMed legal):
"We're investigating intermittent failures for generation calls. We've applied a mitigation and expect service to stabilize. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause. If you need immediate assistance, DM support."
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated. priority: P1 -> moving to monitoring. elapsed: 23m. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/incident/1778612345
Alice (oncall): handing off to Dinesh for monitoring window. Handoff checklist: 1) watch error rate for 30m 2) keep overrides until confirmed 3) gather config artifacts 4) schedule postmortem with timeline. I'm OOTO in 20m, please escalate to oncall rotation if regress.
Dinesh (infra): ack. I'll monitor dashboards and keep flag for 30m. If any regression, revert to emergency pager.
Ben (sre): capturing runbook steps and adding to incident doc. root cause (prelim): accidental config change that lowered burst/allowed tokens -> quota enforcement cascade -> client retries -> gateway overload -> 5xx. Remediation: revert config, add canary gating for config pushes that touch rate-limiter, add automatic alert on sudden 429->5xx correlation.
Carla (runtime): adding a short-term circuit-breaker change to stop upstream 5xx from propagating: route-level fast-fail when runtime latency > 500ms to fallback model. I'll PR it and set to manual rollout.
Maya (support): customer update sent to affected list: 1) incident noticed and mitigated 2) mitigation steps 3) next update after postmortem.
Support Lead: great. please assign follow-ups: config gating -> infra, canary -> release infra, circuit-breaker -> runtime, customer comms -> support.
Alice (oncall): closing live thread for now. leave comments on incident doc for any late updates. :white_check_mark:
